name: Battery management (BMS) boards
summary: Protection and balance boards that stop lithium packs over-charging, over-discharging or shorting.
uses: Replacing a failed board on an e-bike or tool pack
Low-voltage cutoff for a small battery system
identify: A small board with MOSFETs and a chip, wired to every cell junction in a lithium pack: power banks, laptop, drill, e-bike and scooter packs. Labels like 3S, 4S or 13S give the cell count; ratings run 2–100A.
test: Fitted to a pack, the output should match the pack voltage. If output is 0V but the cells are fine, the board may have tripped: briefly connecting a charger usually resets it. Connect balance wires in the right order or the board and pack can burn.

decay.note: Lasts. Some boards slowly drain the pack they sit on.
